above_gcse.text: The pressure due to a column of liquid is given by p = hρg. You are given this equation in the exam.
above_gcse.why: The specification heading reads "4.5.5.1.2 Pressure in a fluid 2 (HT only)". This section covers p = hρg, pressure differences at different depths, upthrust, and floating and sinking. The lesson teaches all of it (keyPoints[1], keyPoints[2], checkpoints 1 and 2, tables[0].rows[1]) as required for every student and never marks it Higher tier only. A Foundation-tier student could think they must learn this content.

wrong_terms.spec_term: pressure = (force normal to a surface)/(area of that surface)

wrong_terms.text: Submerged object: greater pressure on the bottom surface than the top
wrong_terms.spec_term: A partially (or totally) submerged object experiences a greater pressure on the bottom surface than on the top surface.
